l1.f2: Pick up an admission form from the school office.
Your child writes a short exam in English and Mathematics.
Visit with a parent or guardian for a short, friendly interview.
Complete registration and join your new class at the start of term.

visit.f3: Visit on any school day between 8am and 5pm. Tour the classrooms, laboratory and library, and meet our teachers.

entry.f5: For pupils finishing primary school. Children sit the entrance exam in English and Mathematics before joining JSS1.
entry.f8: For students who have completed JSS3 and the BECE. New students choose the Science, Arts or Commercial stream.
entry.f9: Students may also join other classes where space is available.

l1.text: Transfer letter (for students joining from another school)

l1.f1: Is JECK a boys’ or girls’ school?
l1.f2: Neither. JECK is co-educational, so boys and girls learn together from JSS1 to SSS3.

l1.f1: Can my child join in the middle of the session?
l1.f2: Yes, where there is space in the class.

l1.f1: Which exams do students prepare for?
l1.f2: Junior students sit the BECE (Junior WAEC) in JSS3. Senior students prepare for WAEC and NECO in SSS3.
